title: Move in from Invision Community
notes: The Import wizard can now migrate from Invision Community (IPS 4 & 5) — members, forums, topics, posts, tags and reactions. Modern member passwords carry over and log straight in; legacy accounts reset on first login. Invision’s rich-HTML posts (quotes and @mentions) are converted to Convoro’s format automatically.

changelog.text: Invision Community importer (IPS 4 & 5): migrate members, forums, topics, posts, tags and reactions. Passwords carry over where possible; quotes and @mentions in posts are converted automatically.
